_meta.description: PC code map of two Mercenaries 2 engine render subsystems: Render core (#1 — frame driver, scene passes, renderables, materials, texture streaming, shader registry, D3D9 device/RT) and Lighting (#2 — LightObject/LightAnimation ECS, Rt* runtime animations, _pl/_sl/_pl_sl shader permutations, sun/ambient). Companion docs: docs/reverse_engineer/render_core_code_map.md and lighting_code_map.md.
_meta.method: Bridge the Xbox-devkit PDB symbol names (docs/mercs2-pdb-analysis/rendering-shaders.md) + the ECS registry (docs/mercs2-ecs/05_presentation_audio_fx.md) to the PC unpacked decomp (full bodies, symbol-stripped) by string-anchor, struct-offset, call-graph and the shared 0x9e3779b9 reflection backbone. The residual gaps are SecuROM-virtualized indirect branches, .data vtables, and VMX light/shader math, marked confirm-live.
